text:
Type: textured woven throw blanket
Use: warming up on a sofa or an armchair, layering at the foot of a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: soft loosely woven cotton-blend fabric with a slubby texture
Colors: natural beige, warm off-white
Shape: flat rectangular blanket with a subtle grid weave, uneven slubbed surface, simple hemmed edges, folds softly, light but cozy
Feel: soft, warm, calm, cozy
Goes with: grey or white sofas, light wood, linen cushions, neutral palettes; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms
